61a194e2-4e55-494c-bb3e-5d225e267758: This session works out the world's material-history timeline (agriculture, paper, jars, wire, the printing press). The final stretch, on how healing magic works and why it stayed rare, cites enough unpublished worldbuilding that most of it is redacted here — read as: the healing-magic system was designed to be a hard, institutionally-gated contrast to farm magic's easy spread.
